Who We Bring On

Behind the Door isn't interested in polished PR narratives. We bring on the people doing the actual work — and the people who've been through enough that they have something real to say.

Master Technicians

The HVAC tech who can diagnose anything. The plumber who's seen it all. The electrician who built a team from scratch. Their knowledge deserves an audience.

Business Owners

People who took the leap — started their own home service company, grew it through chaos, and learned lessons nobody teaches in business school.

Industry Leaders

Vendors, coaches, recruiters, and innovators who are actively shaping the future of home services — with no agenda except to help the trades grow.

The Comeback Stories

People who hit rock bottom in their career or business, rebuilt, and came out the other side stronger. These are the stories that actually help people.

Want to Be a Guest?

If you've got a story worth telling — whether you're a technician, business owner, or someone who's been in the trenches of the trades — we want to hear from you. No blue-chip resume required. Just a real story and the guts to tell it.
